description: This file contains utility functions for handling HTTP requests in the OpenClaw gateway, including header parsing, authorization, scope resolution, and session management.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a header value from the request, handling string or array types.

methods.name: getBearerToken
methods.description: Extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header.

methods.name: resolveHttpBrowserOriginPolicy
methods.description: Determines the origin policy for HTTP browser requests based on request headers and config.

methods.name: authorizeGatewayHttpRequestOrReply
methods.description: Performs authorization for an incoming HTTP request, returning the method and scope trust info.

methods.name: isGatewayBearerHttpRequest
methods.description: Checks if the request is authenticated via shared secret bearer token.

methods.name: resolveTrustedHttpOperatorScopes
methods.description: Resolves operator scopes from request headers if trust is established.

methods.name: resolveOpenAiCompatibleHttpOperatorScopes
methods.description: Resolves operator scopes with OpenAI compatibility considerations.

methods.name: resolveHttpSenderIsOwner
methods.description: Determines if the request sender has owner privileges based on scopes.

methods.name: resolveOpenAiCompatibleHttpSenderIsOwner
methods.description: Checks owner privileges with OpenAI compatibility considerations.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromHeader
methods.description: Extracts agent ID from specific request headers.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromModel
methods.description: Resolves agent ID based on model string and config.

methods.name: resolveOpenAiCompatModelOverride
methods.description: Overrides model based on request headers and validation.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdForRequest
methods.description: Determines agent ID from headers or model.

methods.name: resolveSessionKey
methods.description: Generates session key based on request, user, and prefix.

methods.name: resolveGatewayRequestContext
methods.description: Builds context including agent ID, session key, and message channel for a request.
